description: This Java class defines enumeration mappings for account transfer types, recurrence types, instruction priorities, statuses, and types within the Fineract project, providing methods to convert integer or enum values into EnumOptionData objects with descriptive labels.

classes.name: AccountTransferEnumerations
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to convert account transfer related enums and types into EnumOptionData objects with labels.

methods.name: accountType
methods.description: Converts an Integer or PortfolioAccountType to an EnumOptionData with account type description.

methods.name: recurrenceType
methods.description: Converts an Integer or AccountTransferRecurrenceType to an EnumOptionData with recurrence type description.

methods.name: transferType
methods.description: Converts an Integer or AccountTransferType to an EnumOptionData with transfer type description.

methods.name: standingInstructionPriority
methods.description: Converts an Integer or StandingInstructionPriority to an EnumOptionData with priority description.

methods.name: standingInstructionStatus
methods.description: Converts an Integer or StandingInstructionStatus to an EnumOptionData with status description.

methods.name: standingInstructionType
methods.description: Converts an Integer or StandingInstructionType to an EnumOptionData with instruction type description.
